privacyEvidence.localData: Worship history, bookmarks and settings are local-first. Optional exports encrypt the selected personal-data allowlist before writing a temporary .nuurbackup file; the user chooses the share destination. The app cleans its temporary copy, not copies saved with external providers. Passwords are not persisted. User-directed export destinations and any OS-managed device backups require disclosure; local-first is not a blanket no-data-leaves-device claim.
privacyEvidence.manifest: Application manifest declares precise location for functionality, not linked and not tracking. Required-reason APIs are also declared. A manifest is not an App Store privacy-label submission.
privacyEvidence.ownerQuestion: Confirm actual retention/use of IP, location and request data by every production partner, support mailbox handling, intended backups and production SDK settings before selecting privacy labels.

encryptionEvidence.backupImplementation: iPhone-only encrypted backup uses Apple CryptoKit AES-256-GCM, Apple CommonCrypto PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 600000 iterations, and Security SecRandomCopyBytes for fresh salt and nonce. No bundled custom AES, KDF or random-number algorithm implements this feature. The JSON envelope is an application file format, not a proprietary cryptographic algorithm.
encryptionEvidence.technicalExemptionInference: Apple's current documentation table lists OS-only encryption as requiring no App Store Connect documentation. The reviewed backup primitives are OS-provided, supporting retention of false for this feature. This is an engineering inference, not a certification of the entire final binary or the owner's regulatory obligations.
encryptionEvidence.reviewLimits: All linked libraries, release configuration, distribution territories and any government reporting obligations still require release-owner review. App Store documentation exemption does not mean the app uses no encryption or that all export/import requirements disappear. No submission or compliance questionnaire was completed.
